brief: 6 shipping principles I stole from teams that release every day.

slots.subText: Teams that release daily don't move fast because they're reckless. They move fast because they built systems that make shipping boring.

slots.title: SHIP THE SMALLEST
slots.subtitle: Big releases hide big risks, while tiny diffs make bugs obvious and reversals instant.
slots.codeComment: // deploy one line, watch it work
slots.b1Body: If something breaks, you know exactly which two lines caused it.
slots.b2Body: Peers can review fifty lines in minutes, not five hundred in days.

slots.title: MERGE TO MAIN
slots.subtitle: Long-lived branches rot, so mainline keeps code fresh, integrated, and actually shippable.
slots.b1Body: Integrating daily means conflicts resolve while they're still small.
slots.b2Body: Main is production-ready at any moment, not just at sprint end.

slots.title: HIDE UNFINISHED WORK
slots.subtitle: Deploy incomplete features behind flags so code moves without exposing broken edges.
slots.b1Body: Push code to production even when the full feature isn't user-ready yet.
slots.b2Body: Turn off a flag in seconds instead of reverting an entire release.

slots.title: AUTOMATE THE GUARDRAILS
slots.subtitle: Manual QA is a bottleneck because pipelines run tests, lint, and security checks in minutes.
slots.b1Body: Developers learn they broke something before they context-switch away.
slots.b2Body: Shipping isn't gated on someone manually clicking through staging at 5 PM.

slots.title: OBSERVE THEN ROLL FORWARD
slots.subtitle: You can't ship daily if every deploy requires a war room, so monitor, alert, and recover fast.
slots.b1Body: Dashboards and alerts surface issues before users flood support channels.
slots.b2Body: Forward-fix culture keeps momentum; rollbacks are the last resort.

slots.title: MAKE SHIPPING BORING
slots.subtitle: The best teams treat releases as routine, not rituals, because boring deploys are safe deploys.
slots.b1Body: Psychological safety means people admit mistakes so systems improve.
slots.b2Body: Documented steps turn heroics into habits anyone can execute.

slots.ctaBody: Pick one principle this week and make your next release smaller, faster, and less dramatic than the last.
